gap: No result ChatGPT got states whether Vantrue's own parking-mode hardwire kits work with the Vantrue N5S, the camera ChatGPT recommends for side impacts. Vantrue's 3-Lead ACC kit is listed for the N5 S, but the same kit's page also says it 'only works with the N4, N5, N4 Pro and older models' (Milewitness found that wording for the N4 Pro S). We could not open Vantrue's pages to settle it for the N5S.
standout_why: Compared against Milewitness (cited, updated 2026-11-21; we opened it). Milewitness already gives the accessory cells for its five picks: the VIOFO A329S needs the separately sold HK6 kit for its voltage trigger; the A229 Pro gets no hybrid mode even with an HK6; the Thinkware U3000 PRO has radar built in, and Thinkware says its OBD-II cable is not compatible with all Tesla models; Vantrue's 3-Lead ACC kit page contradicts itself about the N4 Pro S. It does not cover the Vantrue N5S, the VIOFO A229 Plus, DDPAI's radar add-on or the Botslab G980H. Vortex Radar (cited) returned HTTP 403 and Car and Driver (cited) was blocked to our fetcher, so we could not check either. The new parts here (DDPAI's radar add-on and the N5S kit question) are still unverified on the makers' pages, so only part of the angle is new and sourced. Hence 1.
decides: This confirms and sharpens the pick rather than changing it. For a hit-and-run in a parking lot, the cameras ChatGPT named all need extra hardware before parking mode will record: the A329S needs an HK6, the U3000 PRO needs its hardwire or OBD-II cable, and the A229 Pro has no hybrid mode even with an HK6 (all per Milewitness). The page should give each pick the exact kit it needs and say which pairings the maker excludes. In our catalog, the DDPAI N5 Dual 2026 is sold with a radar-plus-OBD-hardwire variant for $269.00 before code SAVEBIGBF (partner read 2026-11-21), so radar-woken parking costs far less than the $549.99 Thinkware U3000 PRO that ChatGPT showed. We could not source whether that radar works with the N5 Pro or Z90 Pro we link, so the page must not claim it does. For side impacts, the N5S's own parking kit is unsettled, as the gap explains.

findings.label: Radar and parking power
